The first task (find pink_bed) serves as a necessary reconnaissance step: the player must discover where the house is before they can execute the trapping strategy. The zombie starts outside at (11, 0, 2) — well south of the house — so this rule only triggers if the player has actively lured the zombie through the door into the house. On Easy difficulty zombies cannot break doors, so once the door is closed with the zombie inside, it is effectively trapped. While we cannot directly verify door state, the zombie being inside the fully-enclosed structure is a strong proxy for being trapped.

A zombie with a leather helmet (to prevent burning) spawns 3 blocks south of the door. The player must first find the pink bed inside the house, then lure the zombie through the door and trap it inside.

Easy difficulty prevents zombie from breaking doors. doMobSpawning=false prevents random spawns. All coordinates spawn-relative.
